in-gĕnĭcŭlus , a, um, adj. in-geniculum,
I.kneeling: Ingeniculus, sc. Hercules, a constellation: in extremis partibus oritur Ingeniculus, qui a Graeeis ἐν γόνασιν dicitur, Firm. Math. 8, 17: “ingenicla (by sync. for ingenicula) imago,” Manil. 5, 645 ; v. ‡ engonasi.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
